related_questions.question: What are 5 signs of poor mental wellbeing?
related_questions.title: Examples of signs and symptoms include:
list: Confused thinking or reduced ability to concentrate.
Excessive fears or worries, or extreme feelings of guilt.
Extreme mood changes of highs and lows.
Significant tiredness, low energy or problems sleeping.
